description: This file defines the ProfileReader class, which reads user profile information from a database, including details about follow relationships, and maps database entities to API response models.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: Implements IProfileReader to fetch and assemble profile data, including follow status, for a given username.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a profile by username, checks current user follow status, and returns a ProfileEnvelope object.
